observations.code_quote: Marker trust mirrors the conflict autoresolver: the helper only reads and updates comments authored by `MQ_TRIAGE_BOT_LOGIN`, the login the sweep's comments are authored by, and fails closed without it. Use the value as given; never derive it from your token's own API identity, which is not always the account that authors your comments. `get` exits 3 when the PR carries a complete marker written under a different bot login, which means `MQ_TRIAGE_BOT_LOGIN` is wrong: stop the sweep and report it, because continuing re-triages every PR and appends a comment per run. The sweep works entirely from the default-branch clone — it never checks out a PR ref — so the helper it invokes is always the checked-in one.
